name: Financial Instrument Reporting Cancellation Report V 01
definition: This FinancialInstrumentReportingCancellationReport message is sent by the trading venue to the national competent authority to cancel reference data previously reported by mistake.

ReportHeader.name: Report Header
ReportHeader.definition: Header information related to the global report.

CancellationData.name: Cancellation Data
CancellationData.definition: Details of the financial instrument previously reported by mistake by the trading venue.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
